review_scope: one exact unprivileged offline native build; no module load, guest, application, cleanup or retry

review.owner_validate_only: PASS under /usr/bin/python3; no Docker client or lease
review.docker_census: 13 containers; two unrelated services running; historical build containers terminal and no mount intersects fresh roots
review.owner_lifecycle: terminal container remains retained after creation, including late failure; proven client retirement permits lease release only after durable receipt publication
review.failure_family: prior 67589154 build phase-0 failure is not retried; fresh source includes the corrected queue checker and terminal-retention owner

resource_admission.candidate_and_backup_mount: tmpfs device 26 with no descendant mounts

fresh_checks_required: fetched release and exact input hashes
candidate and metadata-backup device/inode/mode and clean pinned commits
empty output/evidence roots and absent exact lease and lock
all relevant leases, launcher/process identities and competing build/guest owners
complete privileged read-only Docker census and mount exclusion
host and MemAvailable at least 16 GiB, scratch at least 12 GiB, tmpfs at least 4 GiB
aggregate requirement at most 24 GiB with the dispatcher as sole heavy owner
preflight.failure_rule: Any changed input, nonempty destination, active owner/lock, Docker conflict, incomplete census or failed resource floor blocks execution.

execution.outer_timeout: none shorter than owner 19800-second wait plus cleanup/evidence publication
execution.outer_capture: exclusive stdout/stderr, start/end, exact argv, exit and owner PID/starttime

always_keep: all phase commands, statuses and logs
all original failures and preparation evidence

next_on_success: independently inspect exact artifacts and complete evidence, then seek separate current-candidate diagnostic application execution release
next_diagnostic: smallest real libc memory application smoke; diagnostic only, not formal M04 acceptance
